title: Responsive navigation bar with menu toggle
when: The user wants a site header with a logo and links that collapses into a menu button on small screens.
prompt:
Goal: A header nav that shows links inline on wide screens and behind one labeled toggle on phones, fully usable by keyboard.
Steps:
1. <header> with the brand link, <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="site-menu">Menu</button> and <nav aria-label="Main"> holding <ul id="site-menu">.
2. Mark the current link with aria-current="page" and an underline or weight, not color alone.
3. Below 720 px the list stays collapsed unless the nav has data-open; from @media (min-width: 720px) hide the toggle and use display: flex.
4. The toggle flips aria-expanded and data-open; Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle.
5. Close the menu when a link is chosen or when matchMedia reports the wide layout.
6. Links get a 44 px hit area and a :focus-visible outline with an offset.
Quality bar:
- Without JS the links stay reachable: the script adds the collapsed state.
- The toggle icon is aria-hidden.
- Header height does not jump when the menu opens.
Pitfalls:
- A div with a click listener as the toggle.
- role="menu" on site links, which changes keyboard expectations.
- A leftover class hiding links on desktop.
Verify:
- [ ] Links sit in a nav with an aria-label.
- [ ] aria-expanded matches what is visible.
- [ ] Escape closes and focus lands on the toggle.
- [ ] No horizontal scroll at 375 px.
Output: Header markup in the page, nav rules in style.css, nav.js loaded with defer.

examples.input: menu responsivo com hamburguer para o meu site
examples.output: header with logo, nav aria-label Main, Menu toggle with aria-expanded under 720 px, flex row above
